summary: Webhook delivery blocks internal address encodings, redacts capability URLs, and keeps signing secrets off argv and cross-host redirects.
reason: Webhook URLs are bearer capabilities; redirects and alternate IP encodings must not expose credentials or reach private services.
reapply: Block reserved IPv4 ranges, NAT64 and private IPv4 inside 6to4 at URL and dial validation. Redact human URL output and discard raw transport errors. Drop custom signatures across any cross-host redirect and accept bounded first-line stdin secrets with mutually exclusive argv source.
